title: A Treasure Hunt at Home
subtitle: 考点：寻宝游戏 / note / until
passage: Jack's birthday was on Saturday. His sister Kate planned a treasure hunt for him. She hid a small gift somewhere in the apartment and wrote five notes to help Jack find it.

The first note said, “Go to the place where we wash our hands.” Jack ran to the bathroom and found the second note under the soap. That note told him to look behind the sofa in the living room. Each note led him to a new place.

The last note was in the kitchen. It said, “Look inside the biscuit box.” Jack opened it and found a small blue watch. He was very happy. “Thank you, Kate!” he said. Kate smiled and said, “Now let's share the biscuits until our parents come home.”
